spec.description: Haverland Eco-Rad radiator state via the Helki cloud API. Shows reachability, on/off, heating, mode, preset, temperatures, power draw, duty, and window/presence signals per radiator.
1 if the exporter reached the Helki API on the last poll; 0 if unreachable.
spec.title: API reachable

spec.description: 1 when the radiator is switched on. One stat per radiator.
spec.title: Power

spec.description: 1 when the radiator element is actively heating.
spec.title: Heating

spec.description: Operating mode per radiator (off/manual/auto). Label is the mode; value is always 1.
spec.title: Mode

spec.description: Selected preset per radiator (comfort/eco/ice). Label is the preset; value is always 1.
spec.title: Preset

spec.description: Duty cycle per radiator (percentage of time the element is driven).
spec.title: Duty cycle

spec.description: 1 when the radiator detects an open window.
spec.title: Open window

spec.description: 1 when the radiator's presence sensor is triggered.
spec.title: Presence

spec.description: 1 when boost is active on the radiator.
spec.title: Boost

spec.description: Raw error code per radiator when the device reports one.
spec.title: Error codes

spec.description: 1 if this radiator's status was read on the last poll; 0 if offline.
spec.title: Radiator online
